link.title: LaTeX Math Delimiters: Which of the Four to Use, and Where Each Breaks

entry.summary: There are four ways to wrap the same equation, and they are not interchangeable. $x^2 + y^2 = r^2$ $$x^2 + y^2 = r^2$$ \(x^2 + y^2 = r^2\) \[x^2 + y^2 = r^2\] The short answer, if you only need one: in a .tex file use \(…\) and \[…\]; everywhere else — Markdown, Notion, Obsidian, Jupyter, a Word or Google Docs file you intend to convert, a prompt to a chatbot — use $…$ and $$…$$.
